segments.say: Answered, with the sheet. NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra on Nebius Token Factory answered from the index. Nemotron 3 Nano Omni read the sheet on a Nebius AI Cloud endpoint. The boxes are the lettering it relied on.

The Library of Congress holds fifty-five thousand public-domain drawing sets of American buildings. Preservation architects and historians still read them sheet by sheet. None could be asked a question. Until now.
This is Iolani Palace, Honolulu, HABS number H I one: eighty-five pages, twenty-three scanned drawing sheets, fifty-seven photographs.
Nemotron 3 Nano Omni read every sheet on one L40S on Nebius AI Cloud: title, description, every piece of hand lettering with its position. 1,818 entries, read by the model, not typed by us.

Which sheets show the Richards Street elevation. Ultra answers over the evidence pack the index builds, with the sheets as receipts, verified in code: a page that does not exist is flagged, and every quoted span must be on the page it cites.
What does HABS sheet 12 reference. Historic sheets cross-reference by lettering, SEE SHEET N. We type those into links, so the answer carries the lettering as its receipt.

do.text: what wood species is the central stair balustrade

segments.say: And the question every archive tool gets wrong. What wood is the central stair balustrade. The set does not say, so Nemotron answers: not in the set, with the pages it checked. Four outcomes, nothing else.

do.text: what are the walls built of

segments.say: Lahaina, August eighth, 2023. The Old Lahaina Courthouse burned to its walls. HABS had measured it in 1966. The same reader, unchanged, on those drawings: what are the walls built of? Coral, twenty-one inches thick, with rubble and cement plaster. The walls that stood. Three Lahaina buildings are in the repository; ask them what happened in 2023 and the reader says: not in the set.
Open method on open models: MIT on GitHub, public-domain documents from loc dot gov. Nano Omni for the reading, Ultra for the reasoning, both on Nebius. A live demo link is in the description.
Nemotron on Nebius reads it today. Next, we train the eyes on Token Factory. Nothing invents a sheet.
